file: scripts/veritas_patch.py

from pathlib import Path

p = Path("/srv/app/routes.py")
src = p.read_text()

if "V7-applied" in src:
    print("Already patched.")
    raise SystemExit(0)

src = src.replace("old_segments", "new_segments")
p.write_text(src)
print("OK patched")
